patch_note: Adds density/port settings and core-only diagnostic. Anchors total-HPWL parsing, equivalent to the native wrapper used in this campaign.
per_design_resources: See designs.json; cores fixed across arms, aggregate reservation at most 12.
proofs: Source-to-optimized, optimized-to-mapped and mapped-to-final netlist CEC; only proved, zero-DRC, fully routed results count.
scope: Followup backend protocol, separate from original paper settings.
